LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_Qipao.label: (Raven) Qipao (Chest Cover)
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_Qipao.description: An elegant garment combining classic qipao styling with modern design, tailored specifically for the Raven physique. The chest cutout design on the front serves as decoration while providing extra comfort. The fabric is light and breathable, suitable for social activities in warm climates while offering basic protection.
